drafts.passage: On the original Corvane-News NER labels, Thornbill-NER achieved a mean test F1 of 91.4% ± 0.4, slightly higher than the Lindgren-Tagger baseline's 90.8% ± 0.5, with a smaller seed range (0.9 vs 1.2 points). The package provides no experiments with label noise, so the robustness of Thornbill-NER to label noise cannot be assessed from the supplied evidence. Consequently, no claim about robustness to label noise is supported by the data.
